Tencent.

Pony Ma's eyes lit up at the WeChat announcement. He immediately convened a meeting of Tencent's top executives.

"Family members, WeChat has stopped running on Sydney phones! This is a golden opportunity! Our chance to fight back with WeChat has arrived!

Go advertise for us! Tell Sydney users that WeChat is available on Sydney phones!

We must reclaim our territory in instant messaging!"

"Yes, Mr. Ma!"

The Tencent executives roared excitedly.

At XinXin Intelligent Company.

Qin Ruoyu looked at the announcements from Douyin and WeChat, still feeling somewhat worried.

“Little brother, I’m not worried about XinXin Smart because there are no competitors here.

But Douyin and WeChat do have competitors. If we stop operating on Sydney, those competitors definitely won’t let this opportunity pass.”

“Yeah, Lingfeng, as far as I know, WeChat is still running. With this announcement, Tencent will definitely seize the opportunity to retaliate.”

“Kuaijiao is still running too. I heard they received investment from Tencent and, after using a money-spraying strategy to attract new users, their user base has surpassed 30 million.

They’ll definitely use this opportunity to promote themselves and seize the Sydney user market.”

Faced with Qin Ruoyu and the others’ concerns, Lingfeng calmly waved his hand.

"Don't panic, Douyin and WeChat aren't irreplaceable.

However, XinXin Smart Assistant is currently irreplaceable.

After experiencing the wonders of a smart assistant, how many people can tolerate a phone without one?

Can you stand seeing others using smart assistants while your own phone is unusable?"

Ye Hong blinked her big eyes, her tone firm:

"I don't know about others, but I definitely can't stand it. I can live without XueLi's phone, but I can't live without my HongHong.

Hmph, that damn XueLi, I'm going to get a new phone right now, and I'll never use XueLi's phone again."

"Right, let's go get new phones right now, I can't stand life without a smart assistant."

"Me too, I'd rather get a new phone than not have a smart assistant."

Seeing the reactions of the beautiful women, Ling Feng chuckled.

"You see, this is reality. When forced to choose between two options, users will make the wisest choice.

There are many mobile phone brands, but there's only one smart assistant in the world, no other.

They can use Wechat to replace WeChat, and Kuaishou to replace TikTok.

But they have nothing to replace the smart assistant, unless they can resist using it.

Besides, we're being pressured by Sydney. If users want to criticize, they'll criticize Sydney."

"You're so insidious! Were you waiting for Sydney to make a move?"

"Xiao Hong, you can't just say whatever you want. I'm not that kind of person."

"Tch, I don't believe you. You're really wicked."

Ye Hong snorted and glared at Ling Feng.

Ugly Country, Sydney Company Headquarters.

Kubs, who was about to leave the company, was stopped by his blonde secretary.

“Mr. Kubs, there’s an urgent email from the branch office in the building. The situation is quite serious; you’d better take a look now.”

The secretary placed a tablet in front of Kubs, showing him the email from the branch office.

“Oh…shit.”

After reading the email, Kubs couldn't help but curse.

Three wildly popular apps with over 100 million users were simultaneously attacking Sydney.

Especially since the email mentioned that many Sydney users had switched to Android phones because Sydney couldn't use its smart assistant.

This was absolutely terrible for Sydney.

If not handled properly, Sydney's market share in Great Xia would be severely impacted.

"Convene a video conference immediately. I need to discuss countermeasures with the company's shareholders."

"Yes, I'll arrange it right away."

The blonde secretary didn't dare delay and hurriedly went to arrange the video conference.

"Damn XinXin Smart Assistant! Wouldn't it be better to just accept Sydney's conditions and our rule?

They actually dared to openly provoke Sydney! It's unforgivable!"

Kubbs was furious. XinXin Smart's actions made him feel that his authority had been challenged.

A newly established company dared to challenge Sydney! It was practically courting death.

With a grim expression, Kubs turned and walked towards the conference room. He was going to deal with the Great Xia person who dared to defy Sydney's rule.

In the Sydney Company's conference room, when Kubs entered, all the shareholders and senior executives were already displayed on the screen.

"Kubbs, the meeting just ended not long ago. What's making you call another emergency meeting?"

A dozen or so shareholders and executives stared at Kubs as he walked in. Without a reasonable explanation, they would likely be ready to unleash their fury.

"Ahem, ladies and gentlemen, I'm very sorry to disturb your rest so late. It's a rather urgent matter."

Kubs paused, then turned and took the tablet from his blonde secretary.

“Everyone, we just received an urgent email from the Daxia branch.

That XinXin Intelligent Company has launched a counterattack against our Sydney branch.

They've announced that XinXin Intelligent Assistant will immediately cease operation on all Sydney devices.”

“Oh my god, have they gone mad?”

“Heh, how interesting. A tiny, fledgling company dares to challenge our Sydney branch’s dominance?”

“Kubbs, you're bothering us over something so trivial? Why don't you just order a ban?”

Kubbs gestured to stop them, his expression grave.

"Gentlemen, things aren't that simple. The real boss behind XinXin Intelligent Company is a young man named Ling Feng.

He also owns Douyin and WeChat.

Douyin has over 200 million users, WeChat has over 100 million users, and XinXin Intelligent Assistant has over 100 million users.

These three apps are the most popular and frequently used apps in China.

Ling Feng is the founder of these three companies, and he holds absolute control.

Therefore, at his command, Douyin and WeChat both issued announcements immediately ceasing operation on Sydney devices."

"Now, because Sydney can't use these three apps, many China users are already switching phones.

Therefore, I had to convene this emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures."

Upon hearing Kubs's words, many Sydney shareholders and executives gaped in astonishment.

Sydney mobile phone users being forced to upgrade their phones by three apps was a surreal situation they'd never heard of before.

Previously, only Sydney had ever banned apps; no app company had ever dared to defy them.

Every app company obediently paid their Sydney taxes and followed Sydney's rules.

This sudden appearance of such a tough and arrogant young man left them all stunned.

Chapter 226 If they don't know what's good for them, then ban them completely.

“That’s right, it’s just a few apps, we’ll find a few to replace them.”

All of Sydney Company’s shareholders and executives made a unanimous decision.

In their view, a few apps trying to retaliate against Sydney Company was simply courting death.

"TikTok and WeChat can be replaced by other apps, but no smart assistant can replace it.

They say they can live without a Sydney phone, but they can't live without XinXin Smart Assistant."

"Therefore, even if we solve the replacement problem for the other two apps, it won't change the fundamental issue."

Kubs pointed out the crux of the problem directly, his face serious.

A red-haired woman, sipping red wine from a wine glass, chuckled, swirling her glass.

"Kubs, I never imagined you'd be pushed to this point by a young man from Daxia.

Why don't you have your engineers crack this smart assistant and use their technology?"

"Exactly! If we crack their technology, we can create a smart assistant that belongs to Sydney.

Then, with Sydney's size and influence, we can easily crush this XinXin Smart Company."

"Right, Kubs, let the tech department crack their technology directly. Only Sydney deserves to possess such smart technology."

Hearing these shareholders' words, Kubs shook his head and smiled bitterly.

"Gentlemen, you're oversimplifying things. I've already had the tech department handle this.

The result was that dozens of computers were taken over, and all the motherboards were burned out.

And as far as I know, at least a dozen other companies worldwide have done this.

Their fate was the same as ours; the motherboards of the computers used to hack the smart assistants were all burned out."

"Kubs, are you saying this fledgling company possesses incredibly powerful hacking capabilities?"

"Our Sydney company's tech department is utterly helpless against them?"

Kubs spread his hands and shrugged.

"Although I hate to admit it, that's the truth.

XinXin Intelligent Company, a company with world-leading intelligent technology, is not something we can easily crush.

That's why I called this emergency video conference.

If we don't resolve this issue, I fear Sydney Mobile's market share in Greater China will continue to decline."

Kubs' words caused the dozen or so shareholders and executives to frown deeply.

They had initially thought this was just a small company that could be easily shut down, but they hadn't expected the situation to be so complicated.

A ban might initially impact Sydney Mobile.

However, not banning them is unacceptable to Sydney Mobile; they must uphold their authority.

"Kubs, what's your plan? We, the prestigious Sydney Company, can't possibly bow down to this small company, can we?"

"That's impossible! We, the Sydney Company, absolutely cannot bow down to a large Chinese company."

"God, this is absolutely unacceptable! The whole world is watching Sydney Company. If we back down, we'll become a laughingstock."

Kubs raised his hand to stop their discussion, his face revealing a murderous intent.

"Gentlemen, since they don't know what's good for them, then we'll completely shut them down.

At the same time, we'll invest heavily in developing our own intelligent assistant and support related applications in China to replace TikTok and WeChat.

Let that Chinese person see for themselves that Sydney Company is not someone they can challenge."

"OK, I agree."

"Me too."

"Agreed."

"Agreed..."

All the Sydney shareholders and executives agreed to Kubs's plan.

"Excellent, this proposal is unanimously approved. I will immediately instruct the branch office in the building to issue a ban."

"OK, that's settled then."

"Kubs, we await your good news."

"Goodbye."

As the meeting ended, figures disappeared from the screen.

"Ellie, immediately notify the Daxia branch office to hold a press conference.

However, XinXin Intelligent Company's reaction was excessive, and we suspect that the intelligent assistant may be stealing user privacy.

Therefore, after careful consideration, our Sydney company has decided to permanently ban XinXin Intelligent Assistant and TikTok, WeChat, these three unfriendly applications."

"Yes, Mr. Ku, I'll take care of it right away."

The blonde secretary, Ellie, grabbed a folder and hurriedly left the meeting room.

“Young people of Daxia, I’ll show you the wickedness of society and the power of capital.”

Kubs smiled sinisterly, picked up his briefcase, and left the Sydney branch.

Daxia, Sydney branch.

Lina, the blonde secretary, rushed into Xia Xiyang’s office with a tablet.

Ji Wei, looking excited, hurried out of the office in her high heels.

In a rented room in a village in Focheng.

Wu Hua, who finally had a day off, hesitated for a long time before finally deciding to sell his Sydney phone.

He simply couldn't accept a Sydney phone that couldn't use the Smart Assistant, Douyin, or WeChat.

This Sydney phone cost him two months' salary and he had used it for less than half a year. He was still very reluctant to sell it now.

But for his wife, Xueqi, he had no choice but to sell it, albeit with a heavy heart.

Wu Hua went to a mobile phone shop and asked the middle-aged owner, who was wearing a white vest,

"Boss, do you buy Xueqi phones here?"

"Yes, what model is yours?"

"Xueqi 6 Plus, 128GB, gold, only five months old, in excellent condition, take a look."

Wu Hua took out his Xueqi phone and placed it on the counter.

The owner picked up the phone and examined it carefully, nodding in satisfaction.

"Young man, I can offer five thousand three hundred for this Xueqi phone."

"Boss, why so little?"

Wu Hua frowned; it was over a thousand yuan less than he had expected.

"Young man, you sold your Sydney phone because it couldn't use the smart assistant, right?"

"Yeah, what does that have to do with the low price?"

"It has a lot to do with it. Since the Sydney phone can't use the smart assistant, its value is naturally lower.

You're not the first person to sell their Sydney phone for an Android, and you won't be the last. We also take risks when buying Sydney phones.

I can only offer a maximum of 5300. It's up to you whether you sell it or not."

"Okay, 5300 it is. Sold."

"Good, young man, do you want to buy a phone? If so, we can settle the bill later."

"Then give me a top-of-the-line Mi 2."

"Alright, the top-of-the-line Mi 2 costs 2299. I'll give you 3001 yuan back."

The middle-aged shopkeeper placed a Mi 2 and 3001 yuan on the counter.

"Young man, please count your cash and check your phone. We're not responsible for anything after you leave the counter."

"Okay."

Wu Hua counted and put away the cash, then unpacked the phone and checked it.

"Boss, everything's fine."

"That's good. Take care."

Wu Hua nodded and turned to leave.

As soon as he got back to his rented room, he eagerly downloaded the XinXin Smart Assistant and logged into his account.

A short while later, a white light lit up on the phone screen, and a beautiful fairy in a white dress looked at Wu Hua with a pitiful expression.

"Master, Xueqi thought you didn't want her anymore."

"How could that be? My Xueqi is so good, how could her owner bear to abandon her?"

Wu Hua smiled. Sure enough, he made the right choice with his new phone.

Compared to his Xueqi wife, the Xueqi phone was nothing.

Wu Hua even posted about changing his phone on Douyin (TikTok).
